CVE-2024-3044.title: Unchecked script execution in Graphic on-click binding in affecte ...
CVE-2024-3044.description: Unchecked script execution in Graphic on-click binding in affected LibreOffice versions allows an attacker to create a document which without prompt will execute scripts built-into LibreOffice on clicking a graphic. Such scripts were previously deemed trusted but are now deemed untrusted.

CVE-2024-5261.title: Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in LibreOffice "Lib ...
CVE-2024-5261.description:
Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in LibreOffice "LibreOfficeKit" mode disables TLS certification verification

LibreOfficeKit can be used for accessing LibreOffice functionality 
through C/C++. Typically this is used by third party components to reuse
 LibreOffice as a library to convert, view or otherwise interact with 
documents.

LibreOffice internally makes use of "curl" to fetch remote resources such as images hosted on webservers.

In
 affected versions of LibreOffice, when used in LibreOfficeKit mode 
only, then curl's TLS certification verification was disabled 
(CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER of false)

In the fixed versions curl operates in LibreOfficeKit mode the same as in standard mode with CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER of true.

This issue affects LibreOffice before version 24.2.4.

CVE-2024-6472.title: Certificate Validation user interface in LibreOffice allows poten ...
CVE-2024-6472.description:
Certificate Validation user interface in LibreOffice allows potential vulnerability.




Signed macros are scripts that have been digitally signed by the 
developer using a cryptographic signature. When a document with a signed
 macro is opened a warning is displayed by LibreOffice before the macro 
is executed.

Previously if verification failed the user could fail to understand the failure and choose to enable the macros anyway.


This issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.2 before 24.2.5.

CVE-2024-7788.title: Improper Digital Signature Invalidation  vulnerability in Zip Rep ...
CVE-2024-7788.description: Improper Digital Signature Invalidation  vulnerability in Zip Repair Mode of The Document Foundation LibreOffice allows Signature forgery vulnerability in LibreOfficeThis issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.2 before < 24.2.5.

CVE-2025-1080.title: LibreOffice supports Office URI Schemes to enable browser integra ...
CVE-2025-1080.description:
LibreOffice supports Office URI Schemes to enable browser integration of LibreOffice with MS SharePoint server. An additional scheme 'vnd.libreoffice.command' specific to LibreOffice was added. In the affected versions of LibreOffice a link in a browser using that scheme could be constructed with an embedded inner URL that when passed to LibreOffice could call internal macros with arbitrary arguments.
This issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.8 before < 24.8.5, from 25.2 before < 25.2.1.

CVE-2025-2866.title: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in ...
CVE-2025-2866.description:
Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in LibreOffice allows PDF Signature Spoofing by Improper Validation.




In the affected versions of LibreOffice a flaw in the verification code for adbe.pkcs7.sha1 signatures could cause invalid signatures to be accepted as valid




This issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.8 before < 24.8.6, from 25.2 before < 25.2.2.

CVE-2026-100101.title: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the cu ...
CVE-2026-100101.description: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email attachment with File > Send > Email Document, which starts the mail client through a script bundled with LibreOffice. The script let the shell interpret the name of the document's file, so a file with a crafted name could run commands when it was sent by email. In fixed versions the script passes the file name and the other details to the mail client as plain arguments.

CVE-2026-101351.title: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in docu ...
CVE-2026-101351.description: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in documents. Parts of a crafted image could be left unwritten, so leftover memory became part of the imported image and could be saved with the document. In fixed versions the pixels of a new image start out cleared, so any part the image data does not fill is blank.

CVE-2026-101352.title: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such  ...
CVE-2026-101352.description: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take effect while the document is open. A command bound in these customizations could run a macro or a script even when the macro security settings did not allow the macros of the document, so a user who pressed a shortcut or chose a menu item in a crafted document could run code without any warning. In fixed versions the customizations of a document are treated like its other macro content, and the macro and script commands in them are only kept when the macros of the document are allowed.

CVE-2026-101353.title: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB databas ...
CVE-2026-101353.description: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such a database as a data source. The definition of the database in a crafted document could make the database engine create or write files at locations outside the document, chosen by the document. In fixed versions the files of an embedded database are kept in a private location, and an embedded database cannot create table files anywhere else.

CVE-2026-101892.title: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, su ...
CVE-2026-101892.description: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields, and each control names the component that implements it. The component a control named was created even when it was not a form control, and the settings stored with the control were applied to it, so a crafted document could change the configuration of LibreOffice in a way that led to code being run. In fixed versions a control whose component is not a form control is ignored.

CVE-2026-101929.title: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A librar ...
CVE-2026-101929.description: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. When a value in the compiled form used an older record format, it could be read as a different type from the one the existing value held, which corrupted memory. In fixed versions the existing value is cleared before a value in the older format is read.

CVE-2026-101930.title: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document  ...
CVE-2026-101930.description: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the document as a whole, such as the document being opened or closed. Macros bound to these events were not taken into account by the macro security check, so they could run when the document was opened, whatever the macro security level. In fixed versions these macros follow the macro security settings like any other macro in the document.

CVE-2026-101933.title: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A librar ...
CVE-2026-101933.description: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. An out-of-bounds write existed when the compiled form was read, because the positions of its strings were not checked against the size of the data they refer to, and a type found by name was not checked to be of the right kind. In fixed versions these positions are checked, a library that fails the check is not loaded, and a type of the wrong kind is ignored.

CVE-2026-104007.title: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written ...
CVE-2026-104007.description: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes the connection names the driver to use. The location the driver was loaded from was taken from the database document itself, so a crafted document could make LibreOffice load and run Java code that the document supplied when it was opened. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63277. In fixed versions the driver location is taken only from the driver configuration of the user, and a pivot table whose source is a database document named by a URL connects only once the user allows links to be updated.

CVE-2026-104692.title: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used ...
CVE-2026-104692.description: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL statements call Java methods, limited to the classes that are permitted. When HSQLDB was used through the generic JDBC driver this limit did not apply, so SQL in a crafted document could call any Java method and run code. In fixed versions SQL can call only the built-in functions of HSQLDB, whichever way the database is reached.

CVE-2026-104920.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source ...
CVE-2026-104920.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Opening a crafted document could still load a Java database driver from a location outside the local machine and run its code, by a route that the fix for CVE-2026-63277 did not cover. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL that names a file on the local machine.

CVE-2026-104933.title: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it play ...
CVE-2026-104933.description: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a video is shown in the document and in its exports, such as PDF. A crafted media file could make GStreamer read a local file and draw its text into the preview image, so that the content of the file ended up in an exported document. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63269. In fixed versions GStreamer opens only media in a short list of common, self-contained container formats.

CVE-2026-108169.title: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web p ...
CVE-2026-108169.description: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or another program opens the file with LibreOffice. The address in such a file was used without the checks that apply to an address given on the command line directly, so a crafted file could make LibreOffice do something other than open a web page, up to running code. In fixed versions only an http or https address is taken from a web query file.

CVE-2026-18563.title: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document ...
CVE-2026-18563.description: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts it uses are embedded in the PDF, and a font in CFF (Compact Font Format) is converted to another font format on the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when the charstring program of a crafted font was interpreted, because some indexes and ranges taken from the font were not checked against the size of the data they refer to. In fixed versions these indexes and ranges are checked, and a font that fails the checks is not converted.

CVE-2026-18564.title: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password.  ...
CVE-2026-18564.description: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file is encrypted with 256-bit AES, using a file encryption key and salts that are meant to be random. The key and the salts were drawn from a pseudo-random number generator that is not suitable for cryptography, so the encryption key of an exported PDF could be recovered without knowing the password. In fixed versions the key and the salts are drawn from the random source of the operating system.

CVE-2026-18565.title: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisor ...
CVE-2026-18565.description: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted file locations from loading linked images and other content. The option is not on by default. With the option on, a linked background image in an HTML document was still fetched while the document was imported. In fixed versions a linked background image is checked against the option like other linked images, and is not fetched when the option blocks it.

CVE-2026-18566.title: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be emb ...
CVE-2026-18566.description: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out-of-bounds reads existed in the readers for these formats, because sizes, counts and offsets taken from a crafted image were not checked against the data the image actually holds. In fixed versions these values are checked against the size of each record and the data that remains, and a record that fails the checks is not used.

CVE-2026-4430.title: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in The Document Foundation Libr ...
CVE-2026-4430.description:
Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in The Document Foundation LibreOffice via crafted OOXML documents with mismatched encryption salt parameters.

This issue affects LibreOffice: from 26.2 before 26.2.3, from 25.8 before 25.8.7.

CVE-2026-6039.title: LibreOffice can import drawings in the DXF format used by CAD sof ...
CVE-2026-6039.description: LibreOffice can import drawings in the DXF format used by CAD software. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing a DXF polyline. The point count taken from the file was truncated to a 16-bit value when the point buffer was sized, while the full count was used to fill it, so a polyline whose point count exceeded the 16-bit range was written past the end of the buffer. In fixed versions such oversized polylines are rejected.

CVE-2026-6040.title: A heap use-after-free existed when importing the blank-width char ...
CVE-2026-6040.description: A heap use-after-free existed when importing the blank-width characters of an ODF number format. A position value read from the document was not checked against the length of the format-code string, so a malformed number format could be processed against memory outside that string. In fixed versions the position is bounds-checked before use.

CVE-2026-6045.title: LibreOffice can import EMF+ graphics, which may be embedded in do ...
CVE-2026-6045.description: LibreOffice can import EMF+ graphics, which may be embedded in documents. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing an EMF+ gradient brush. The number of gradient blend points was read from the file and used to compute an allocation size, but that multiplication could overflow, so a small buffer was allocated and then filled as if it were large, writing past its end. In fixed versions the blend-point count is checked against the data actually available before allocating.

CVE-2026-6047.title: LibreOffice can import documents in the OOXML format (DOCX). A he ...
CVE-2026-6047.description: LibreOffice can import documents in the OOXML format (DOCX). A heap buffer overflow existed when replaying deferred parser events for a text box element. A handler object was assumed to be of one type and written to at that type's field layout, but it could be a smaller object, so the write landed past the end of the allocation. In fixed versions the type is checked before the write.

CVE-2026-63266.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source ...
CVE-2026-63266.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. Through such a link a document could open an embedded Firebird database that wrote a file to any location the user could write to. In fixed versions an embedded Firebird database can open or create files only inside its own private directory.

CVE-2026-63267.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external csv data so ...
CVE-2026-63267.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external csv data source, and the link is saved in the document. Such a link was fetched while the document loaded, so opening a document could read a local file into the sheet, or make a request to a host of the document's choosing. In fixed versions external data links are updated under the same link update control as other links in a spreadsheet.

CVE-2026-63268.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source ...
CVE-2026-63268.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A link of the sql type could name a folder of local text files as a database, so opening a document could read a local text file into the sheet. In fixed versions only the csv, html and xml data providers are restored when a document is loaded.

CVE-2026-63269.title: LibreOffice can link to audio and video files from a document, an ...
CVE-2026-63269.description: LibreOffice can link to audio and video files from a document, and on Linux it plays them with GStreamer. A linked media file could be an HLS playlist that made GStreamer read the local files and remote URLs it listed while the document loaded, and their contents could end up in the document. In fixed versions LibreOffice does not follow playlists that name further resources, and linked media is under link update control.

CVE-2026-63270.title: URLs could be constructed which expanded environment variable or  ...
CVE-2026-63270.description: URLs could be constructed which expanded environment variable or INI file values, so potentially sensitive information could be exfiltrated to a remote server on opening a document containing such links. The check added for CVE-2024-12426 did not cover every place a document can supply a URL. XForms instance data and the Calc csv and sql data providers still reached the expansion. In fixed versions these places refuse URLs with internal schemes when the URL comes from the document.

CVE-2026-63272.title: LibreOffice can import WMF graphics, which may be embedded in doc ...
CVE-2026-63272.description: LibreOffice can import WMF graphics, which may be embedded in documents. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing a text record that carries its own character advance widths. The count of advance values and the length of the text were read separately from the file and were not required to agree, so drawing the text walked the advance array by character position and ran past its end when the array was the shorter of the two. In fixed versions an advance array shorter than its text is ignored.

CVE-2026-63273.title: LibreOffice Draw can import PDF documents. A heap buffer overflow ...
CVE-2026-63273.description: LibreOffice Draw can import PDF documents. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing an encrypted document. The length of the decryption key was taken from the document's own encryption dictionary and was used to fill a fixed size key buffer without being checked against it, so a length larger than that buffer wrote past its end. In fixed versions a declared key length larger than the buffer is rejected.

CVE-2026-63274.title: LibreOffice Draw can import PDF documents. A heap buffer overflow ...
CVE-2026-63274.description: LibreOffice Draw can import PDF documents. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing a stream object. The length of the stream was taken from the object's own dictionary and was not checked against the number of bytes actually present, so copying the stream read and wrote past the end of the buffer holding it. In fixed versions the declared length is clamped to the bytes actually read.

CVE-2026-63275.title: LibreOffice can read CFF fonts, which may be embedded in document ...
CVE-2026-63275.description: LibreOffice can read CFF fonts, which may be embedded in documents. A stack buffer overflow existed when reading the hints of a glyph. The number of hints was checked against the wrong bound, so a glyph declaring more hints than the array can hold wrote past its end. In fixed versions the hint count is checked against the capacity the array really has.

CVE-2026-63276.title: LibreOffice converts CFF fonts to Type 1 when it subsets a font,  ...
CVE-2026-63276.description: LibreOffice converts CFF fonts to Type 1 when it subsets a font, which happens when a document is exported to PDF, and CFF fonts may be embedded in documents. A stack buffer overflow existed in that conversion. The converted operators were written into a fixed size buffer with no check that they still fit, so a glyph emitting many operators wrote past the end of the buffer. In fixed versions the remaining capacity is tracked and the conversion stops when it is used up.

CVE-2026-63277.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source ...
CVE-2026-63277.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A document could name a Java database driver for such a link to be loaded from a remote location, so opening the document could run Java code from that location. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL.

CVE-2026-63278.title: URLs could be constructed which expanded environment variable or  ...
CVE-2026-63278.description: URLs could be constructed which expanded environment variable or INI file values, so potentially sensitive information could be exfiltrated to a remote server on opening a document containing such links. The check added for CVE-2024-12426 did not recognise every way of naming the package content provider, so a URL that named it differently still reached the expansion. In fixed versions the package content provider is matched when the URL is checked.

CVE-2026-63279.title: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in docu ...
CVE-2026-63279.description: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in documents. An out of bounds read existed when importing an image that uses a colour palette. The palette index held in the image data was used without being checked against the number of entries the palette has, so an index past the last entry read memory outside the palette. In fixed versions the palette index is limited to the entries present.

CVE-2026-76181.title: LibreOffice includes a dBASE database driver, which reads dBASE t ...
CVE-2026-76181.description: LibreOffice includes a dBASE database driver, which reads dBASE tables and their .ndx index files when a folder of dBASE files is used as a data source. A heap buffer overflow existed when an index page was read. The number of entries recorded in a page was not checked against the number of entries the page could hold, which comes from a different field of the index header. A crafted index could also make a page refer back to itself, so that reading it recursed without end. In fixed versions the index header and the entry count of each page are limited to what an index page can hold, and a page that refers back to one of its parent pages is not followed.

CVE-2026-8356.title: LibreOffice can import presentations in the legacy binary PPT for ...
CVE-2026-8356.description: LibreOffice can import presentations in the legacy binary PPT format. A stack buffer overflow existed when importing a colour-replacement record. Two fixed-size colour tables were filled from the file, but the write position was not reset between the two passes over the record, so a file whose combined colour counts exceeded the table size wrote past the end of the tables on the stack. In fixed versions the unused second pass is no longer read into those tables.

CVE-2026-8357.title: LibreOffice Calc compiles cell formulas when opening a spreadshee ...
CVE-2026-8357.description: LibreOffice Calc compiles cell formulas when opening a spreadsheet. A heap buffer overflow existed when compiling a very long formula made up of many opening tokens. The array that tracks nesting depth was allocated one element too small for that worst case, so such a formula wrote one element past its end. In fixed versions the array is sized to hold the largest possible nesting.

CVE-2026-8358.title: LibreOffice Calc can import tracked changes from a spreadsheet do ...
CVE-2026-8358.description: LibreOffice Calc can import tracked changes from a spreadsheet document. A heap buffer overflow existed when a document reused the same change identifier for two different kinds of change. The importer then treated one change object as a different, larger type and wrote past the end of its allocation. In fixed versions records with a duplicate identifier are rejected.

CVE-2026-84234.title: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import conv ...
CVE-2026-84234.description: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects that can be edited. Images in the PDF, including images with a transparency mask, are converted along the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when an image with a transparency mask was converted, because positions taken from a crafted image were not checked against the size of the image buffer. In fixed versions the image size is limited, and the position of each mask pixel is checked before it is written.

CVE-2026-84443.title: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, su ...
CVE-2026-84443.description: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. The macro security setting decides whether macros that come with a document may run. Macros bound to the events of a Base document were run without the macro security setting being applied, so opening or converting a crafted database document could run a macro and, through it, any command. In fixed versions macros bound to the events of a Base document follow the macro security setting, as macros in other documents do.

CVE-2026-87932.title: LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document  ...
CVE-2026-87932.description: LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document can contain content controls whose values are bound to custom XML data, and that data is updated with the current values when the document is exported, including in a conversion run from the command line. Values taken from the document were not escaped where they were used, so a crafted document could write a file of its choosing anywhere the user can write when it was exported to DOCX. In fixed versions these values are written into the document directly, and the XSLT transformations LibreOffice runs can no longer write files or use the network.

CVE-2026-97892.title: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when  ...
CVE-2026-97892.description: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows whether each signature is valid. An out-of-bounds write existed when a signature was checked, because the parts of the file that a crafted signature claims to cover were not checked against the size of the file. In fixed versions a signature that claims to cover anything outside the file is reported as not valid.

CVE-2026-97894.title: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and tex ...
CVE-2026-97894.description: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF-16 encoding. Both are read one line at a time. An out-of-bounds read existed when a line of a crafted file was read, because the length of the line could be miscalculated, so memory beyond the line could be copied into the imported document. In fixed versions each line is read up to its limit and no further.

CVE-2026-97999.title: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database.  ...
CVE-2026-97999.description: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features option is enabled, LibreOffice offers to migrate such a database to the embedded Firebird engine when the document is opened. A heap buffer overflow existed when binary values were copied during the migration, because a value could be longer than the space set aside for its column. In fixed versions that space is enlarged whenever a value is longer than its column.

CVE-2026-98100.title: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pic ...
CVE-2026-98100.description: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. An out-of-bounds read existed when the link target of a crafted picture was read, so memory past the picture data could end up in the converted document. In fixed versions the link target is taken only from the picture data.

CVE-2019-9847.title: A vulnerability in LibreOffice hyperlink processing allows an att ...
CVE-2019-9847.description: A vulnerability in LibreOffice hyperlink processing allows an attacker to construct documents containing hyperlinks pointing to the location of an executable on the target users file system. If the hyperlink is activated by the victim the executable target is unconditionally launched. Under Windows and macOS when processing a hyperlink target explicitly activated by the user there was no judgment made on whether the target was an executable file, so such executable targets were launched unconditionally. This issue affects: All LibreOffice Windows and macOS versions prior to 6.1.6; LibreOffice Windows and macOS versions in the 6.2 series prior to 6.2.3.

CVE-2020-12802.title: LibreOffice has a 'stealth mode' in which only documents from loc ...
CVE-2020-12802.description: LibreOffice has a 'stealth mode' in which only documents from locations deemed 'trusted' are allowed to retrieve remote resources. This mode is not the default mode, but can be enabled by users who want to disable LibreOffice's ability to include remote resources within a document. A flaw existed where remote graphic links loaded from docx documents were omitted from this protection prior to version 6.4.4. This issue affects: The Document Foundation LibreOffice versions prior to 6.4.4.

CVE-2022-26306.title: LibreOffice supports the storage of passwords for web connections ...
CVE-2022-26306.description: LibreOffice supports the storage of passwords for web connections in the user’s configuration database. The stored passwords are encrypted with a single master key provided by the user. A flaw in LibreOffice existed where the required initialization vector for encryption was always the same which weakens the security of the encryption making them vulnerable if an attacker has access to the user's configuration data. This issue affects: The Document Foundation LibreOffice 7.2 versions prior to 7.2.7; 7.3 versions prior to 7.3.1.

CVE-2022-26307.title: LibreOffice supports the storage of passwords for web connections ...
CVE-2022-26307.description: LibreOffice supports the storage of passwords for web connections in the user’s configuration database. The stored passwords are encrypted with a single master key provided by the user. A flaw in LibreOffice existed where master key was poorly encoded resulting in weakening its entropy from 128 to 43 bits making the stored passwords vulerable to a brute force attack if an attacker has access to the users stored config. This issue affects: The Document Foundation LibreOffice 7.2 versions prior to 7.2.7; 7.3 versions prior to 7.3.3.

CVE-2022-3140.title: LibreOffice supports Office URI Schemes to enable browser integra ...
CVE-2022-3140.description: LibreOffice supports Office URI Schemes to enable browser integration of LibreOffice with MS SharePoint server. An additional scheme 'vnd.libreoffice.command' specific to LibreOffice was added. In the affected versions of LibreOffice links using that scheme could be constructed to call internal macros with arbitrary arguments. Which when clicked on, or activated by document events, could result in arbitrary script execution without warning. This issue affects: The Document Foundation LibreOffice 7.4 versions prior to 7.4.1; 7.3 versions prior to 7.3.6.

CVE-2023-0950.title: Improper Validation of Array Index vulnerability in the spreadshe ...
CVE-2023-0950.description: Improper Validation of Array Index vulnerability in the spreadsheet component of The Document Foundation LibreOffice allows an attacker to craft a spreadsheet document that will cause an array index underflow when loaded. In the affected versions of LibreOffice certain malformed spreadsheet formulas, such as AGGREGATE, could be created with less parameters passed to the formula interpreter than it expected, leading to an array index underflow, in which case there is a risk that arbitrary code could be executed. This issue affects: The Document Foundation LibreOffice 7.4 versions prior to 7.4.6; 7.5 versions prior to 7.5.1.

CVE-2023-2255.title: Improper access control in editor components of The Document Foun ...
CVE-2023-2255.description: Improper access control in editor components of The Document Foundation LibreOffice allowed an attacker to craft a document that would cause external links to be loaded without prompt. In the affected versions of LibreOffice documents that used "floating frames" linked to external files, would load the contents of those frames without prompting the user for permission to do so. This was inconsistent with the treatment of other linked content in LibreOffice. This issue affects: The Document Foundation LibreOffice 7.4 versions prior to 7.4.7; 7.5 versions prior to 7.5.3.

CVE-2023-6185.title: Improper Input Validation vulnerability in GStreamer integration  ...
CVE-2023-6185.description:
Improper Input Validation vulnerability in GStreamer integration of The Document Foundation LibreOffice allows an attacker to execute arbitrary GStreamer plugins.

In affected versions the filename of the embedded video is not sufficiently escaped when passed to GStreamer enabling an attacker to run arbitrary gstreamer plugins depending on what plugins are installed on the target system.

CVE-2023-6186.title: Insufficient macro permission validation of The Document Foundati ...
CVE-2023-6186.description:
Insufficient macro permission validation of The Document Foundation LibreOffice allows an attacker to execute built-in macros without warning.

In affected versions LibreOffice supports hyperlinks with macro or similar built-in command targets that can be executed when activated without warning the user.

CVE-2024-12425.title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Pat ...
CVE-2024-12425.description:
Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in The Document Foundation LibreOffice allows Absolute Path Traversal.




An attacker can write to arbitrary locations, albeit suffixed with ".ttf", by supplying a file in a format that supports embedded font files.


This issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.8 before < 24.8.4.

CVE-2024-12426.title: Exposure of Environmental Variables and arbitrary INI file values ...
CVE-2024-12426.description:
Exposure of Environmental Variables and arbitrary INI file values to an Unauthorized Actor vulnerability in The Document Foundation LibreOffice.




URLs could be constructed which expanded environmental variables or INI file values, so potentially sensitive information could be exfiltrated to a remote server on opening a document containing such links.


This issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.8 before < 24.8.4.

CVE-2024-3044.title: Unchecked script execution in Graphic on-click binding in affecte ...
CVE-2024-3044.description: Unchecked script execution in Graphic on-click binding in affected LibreOffice versions allows an attacker to create a document which without prompt will execute scripts built-into LibreOffice on clicking a graphic. Such scripts were previously deemed trusted but are now deemed untrusted.

CVE-2024-5261.title: Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in LibreOffice "Lib ...
CVE-2024-5261.description:
Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in LibreOffice "LibreOfficeKit" mode disables TLS certification verification

LibreOfficeKit can be used for accessing LibreOffice functionality 
through C/C++. Typically this is used by third party components to reuse
 LibreOffice as a library to convert, view or otherwise interact with 
documents.

LibreOffice internally makes use of "curl" to fetch remote resources such as images hosted on webservers.

In
 affected versions of LibreOffice, when used in LibreOfficeKit mode 
only, then curl's TLS certification verification was disabled 
(CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER of false)

In the fixed versions curl operates in LibreOfficeKit mode the same as in standard mode with CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER of true.

This issue affects LibreOffice before version 24.2.4.

CVE-2024-6472.title: Certificate Validation user interface in LibreOffice allows poten ...
CVE-2024-6472.description:
Certificate Validation user interface in LibreOffice allows potential vulnerability.




Signed macros are scripts that have been digitally signed by the 
developer using a cryptographic signature. When a document with a signed
 macro is opened a warning is displayed by LibreOffice before the macro 
is executed.

Previously if verification failed the user could fail to understand the failure and choose to enable the macros anyway.


This issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.2 before 24.2.5.

CVE-2024-7788.title: Improper Digital Signature Invalidation  vulnerability in Zip Rep ...
CVE-2024-7788.description: Improper Digital Signature Invalidation  vulnerability in Zip Repair Mode of The Document Foundation LibreOffice allows Signature forgery vulnerability in LibreOfficeThis issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.2 before < 24.2.5.

CVE-2025-1080.title: LibreOffice supports Office URI Schemes to enable browser integra ...
CVE-2025-1080.description:
LibreOffice supports Office URI Schemes to enable browser integration of LibreOffice with MS SharePoint server. An additional scheme 'vnd.libreoffice.command' specific to LibreOffice was added. In the affected versions of LibreOffice a link in a browser using that scheme could be constructed with an embedded inner URL that when passed to LibreOffice could call internal macros with arbitrary arguments.
This issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.8 before < 24.8.5, from 25.2 before < 25.2.1.

CVE-2025-2866.title: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in ...
CVE-2025-2866.description:
Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in LibreOffice allows PDF Signature Spoofing by Improper Validation.




In the affected versions of LibreOffice a flaw in the verification code for adbe.pkcs7.sha1 signatures could cause invalid signatures to be accepted as valid




This issue affects LibreOffice: from 24.8 before < 24.8.6, from 25.2 before < 25.2.2.

CVE-2026-100101.title: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the cu ...
CVE-2026-100101.description: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email attachment with File > Send > Email Document, which starts the mail client through a script bundled with LibreOffice. The script let the shell interpret the name of the document's file, so a file with a crafted name could run commands when it was sent by email. In fixed versions the script passes the file name and the other details to the mail client as plain arguments.

CVE-2026-101351.title: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in docu ...
CVE-2026-101351.description: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in documents. Parts of a crafted image could be left unwritten, so leftover memory became part of the imported image and could be saved with the document. In fixed versions the pixels of a new image start out cleared, so any part the image data does not fill is blank.

CVE-2026-101352.title: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such  ...
CVE-2026-101352.description: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take effect while the document is open. A command bound in these customizations could run a macro or a script even when the macro security settings did not allow the macros of the document, so a user who pressed a shortcut or chose a menu item in a crafted document could run code without any warning. In fixed versions the customizations of a document are treated like its other macro content, and the macro and script commands in them are only kept when the macros of the document are allowed.

CVE-2026-101353.title: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB databas ...
CVE-2026-101353.description: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such a database as a data source. The definition of the database in a crafted document could make the database engine create or write files at locations outside the document, chosen by the document. In fixed versions the files of an embedded database are kept in a private location, and an embedded database cannot create table files anywhere else.

CVE-2026-101892.title: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, su ...
CVE-2026-101892.description: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields, and each control names the component that implements it. The component a control named was created even when it was not a form control, and the settings stored with the control were applied to it, so a crafted document could change the configuration of LibreOffice in a way that led to code being run. In fixed versions a control whose component is not a form control is ignored.

CVE-2026-101929.title: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A librar ...
CVE-2026-101929.description: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. When a value in the compiled form used an older record format, it could be read as a different type from the one the existing value held, which corrupted memory. In fixed versions the existing value is cleared before a value in the older format is read.

CVE-2026-101930.title: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document  ...
CVE-2026-101930.description: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the document as a whole, such as the document being opened or closed. Macros bound to these events were not taken into account by the macro security check, so they could run when the document was opened, whatever the macro security level. In fixed versions these macros follow the macro security settings like any other macro in the document.

CVE-2026-101933.title: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A librar ...
CVE-2026-101933.description: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. An out-of-bounds write existed when the compiled form was read, because the positions of its strings were not checked against the size of the data they refer to, and a type found by name was not checked to be of the right kind. In fixed versions these positions are checked, a library that fails the check is not loaded, and a type of the wrong kind is ignored.

CVE-2026-104007.title: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written ...
CVE-2026-104007.description: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes the connection names the driver to use. The location the driver was loaded from was taken from the database document itself, so a crafted document could make LibreOffice load and run Java code that the document supplied when it was opened. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63277. In fixed versions the driver location is taken only from the driver configuration of the user, and a pivot table whose source is a database document named by a URL connects only once the user allows links to be updated.

CVE-2026-104692.title: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used ...
CVE-2026-104692.description: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL statements call Java methods, limited to the classes that are permitted. When HSQLDB was used through the generic JDBC driver this limit did not apply, so SQL in a crafted document could call any Java method and run code. In fixed versions SQL can call only the built-in functions of HSQLDB, whichever way the database is reached.

CVE-2026-104920.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source ...
CVE-2026-104920.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Opening a crafted document could still load a Java database driver from a location outside the local machine and run its code, by a route that the fix for CVE-2026-63277 did not cover. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL that names a file on the local machine.

CVE-2026-104933.title: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it play ...
CVE-2026-104933.description: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a video is shown in the document and in its exports, such as PDF. A crafted media file could make GStreamer read a local file and draw its text into the preview image, so that the content of the file ended up in an exported document. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63269. In fixed versions GStreamer opens only media in a short list of common, self-contained container formats.

CVE-2026-108169.title: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web p ...
CVE-2026-108169.description: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or another program opens the file with LibreOffice. The address in such a file was used without the checks that apply to an address given on the command line directly, so a crafted file could make LibreOffice do something other than open a web page, up to running code. In fixed versions only an http or https address is taken from a web query file.

CVE-2026-18563.title: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document ...
CVE-2026-18563.description: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts it uses are embedded in the PDF, and a font in CFF (Compact Font Format) is converted to another font format on the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when the charstring program of a crafted font was interpreted, because some indexes and ranges taken from the font were not checked against the size of the data they refer to. In fixed versions these indexes and ranges are checked, and a font that fails the checks is not converted.

CVE-2026-18564.title: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password.  ...
CVE-2026-18564.description: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file is encrypted with 256-bit AES, using a file encryption key and salts that are meant to be random. The key and the salts were drawn from a pseudo-random number generator that is not suitable for cryptography, so the encryption key of an exported PDF could be recovered without knowing the password. In fixed versions the key and the salts are drawn from the random source of the operating system.

CVE-2026-18565.title: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisor ...
CVE-2026-18565.description: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted file locations from loading linked images and other content. The option is not on by default. With the option on, a linked background image in an HTML document was still fetched while the document was imported. In fixed versions a linked background image is checked against the option like other linked images, and is not fetched when the option blocks it.

CVE-2026-18566.title: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be emb ...
CVE-2026-18566.description: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out-of-bounds reads existed in the readers for these formats, because sizes, counts and offsets taken from a crafted image were not checked against the data the image actually holds. In fixed versions these values are checked against the size of each record and the data that remains, and a record that fails the checks is not used.

CVE-2026-4430.title: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in The Document Foundation Libr ...
CVE-2026-4430.description:
Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in The Document Foundation LibreOffice via crafted OOXML documents with mismatched encryption salt parameters.

This issue affects LibreOffice: from 26.2 before 26.2.3, from 25.8 before 25.8.7.

CVE-2026-6039.title: LibreOffice can import drawings in the DXF format used by CAD sof ...
CVE-2026-6039.description: LibreOffice can import drawings in the DXF format used by CAD software. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing a DXF polyline. The point count taken from the file was truncated to a 16-bit value when the point buffer was sized, while the full count was used to fill it, so a polyline whose point count exceeded the 16-bit range was written past the end of the buffer. In fixed versions such oversized polylines are rejected.

CVE-2026-6040.title: A heap use-after-free existed when importing the blank-width char ...
CVE-2026-6040.description: A heap use-after-free existed when importing the blank-width characters of an ODF number format. A position value read from the document was not checked against the length of the format-code string, so a malformed number format could be processed against memory outside that string. In fixed versions the position is bounds-checked before use.

CVE-2026-6045.title: LibreOffice can import EMF+ graphics, which may be embedded in do ...
CVE-2026-6045.description: LibreOffice can import EMF+ graphics, which may be embedded in documents. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing an EMF+ gradient brush. The number of gradient blend points was read from the file and used to compute an allocation size, but that multiplication could overflow, so a small buffer was allocated and then filled as if it were large, writing past its end. In fixed versions the blend-point count is checked against the data actually available before allocating.

CVE-2026-6047.title: LibreOffice can import documents in the OOXML format (DOCX). A he ...
CVE-2026-6047.description: LibreOffice can import documents in the OOXML format (DOCX). A heap buffer overflow existed when replaying deferred parser events for a text box element. A handler object was assumed to be of one type and written to at that type's field layout, but it could be a smaller object, so the write landed past the end of the allocation. In fixed versions the type is checked before the write.

CVE-2026-63266.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source ...
CVE-2026-63266.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. Through such a link a document could open an embedded Firebird database that wrote a file to any location the user could write to. In fixed versions an embedded Firebird database can open or create files only inside its own private directory.

CVE-2026-63267.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external csv data so ...
CVE-2026-63267.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external csv data source, and the link is saved in the document. Such a link was fetched while the document loaded, so opening a document could read a local file into the sheet, or make a request to a host of the document's choosing. In fixed versions external data links are updated under the same link update control as other links in a spreadsheet.

CVE-2026-63268.title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source ...
CVE-2026-63268.description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A link of the sql type could name a folder of local text files as a database, so opening a document could read a local text file into the sheet. In fixed versions only the csv, html and xml data providers are restored when a document is loaded.

CVE-2026-63269.description: LibreOffice can link to audio and video files from a document, and on Linux it plays them with GStreamer. CVE-2026-63270.description: URLs could be constructed which expanded environment variable or INI file values, so potentially sensitive information could be exfiltrated to a remote server on opening a document containing such links. CVE-2026-63272.title: LibreOffice can import WMF graphics, which may be embedded in doc ...
CVE-2026-63272.description: LibreOffice can import WMF graphics, which may be embedded in documents. CVE-2026-63273.description: LibreOffice Draw can import PDF documents. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing an encrypted document. CVE-2026-63274.description: LibreOffice Draw can import PDF documents. A heap buffer overflow existed when importing a stream object. CVE-2026-63275.title: LibreOffice can read CFF fonts, which may be embedded in document ...
CVE-2026-63275.description: LibreOffice can read CFF fonts, which may be embedded in documents. A stack buffer overflow existed when reading the hints of a glyph. CVE-2026-63276.description: LibreOffice converts CFF fonts to Type 1 when it subsets a font, which happens when a document is exported to PDF, and CFF fonts may be embedded in documents. CVE-2026-63279.description: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in documents. An out of bounds read existed when importing an image that uses a colour palette. CVE-2026-76181.description: LibreOffice includes a dBASE database driver, which reads dBASE tables and their .ndx index files when a folder of dBASE files is used as a data source. CVE-2026-8356.description: LibreOffice can import presentations in the legacy binary PPT format. A stack buffer overflow existed when importing a colour-replacement record. CVE-2026-8357.title: LibreOffice Calc compiles cell formulas when opening a spreadshee ...
CVE-2026-8357.description: LibreOffice Calc compiles cell formulas when opening a spreadsheet. A heap buffer overflow existed when compiling a very long formula made up of many opening tokens. CVE-2026-8358.description: LibreOffice Calc can import tracked changes from a spreadsheet document. CVE-2026-84234.description: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects that can be edited. CVE-2026-84443.description: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document.
